test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The area of the base of a conical tomb is 616 m² and its height is 48 m. What is the cost of plastering its curved surface area at Rs. 150 per m²? (Take pi =(22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

The area of the base of the tomb is 616 m2

Height of the tomb = 48 m

**Concept used:**

Area of the base of a cone = πr²

l = √(r² + h²)

Curved surface area of a cone = πrl

r = radius of the base

l = slant height of the cone

h = height of the cone

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

πr² = 616

⇒ r2 = 616 × (7/22)

⇒ r2 = 28 × 7

⇒ r2 = 196

⇒ r = √196

⇒ r = 14

Now,

l = √(14² + 48²)

⇒ l = √(196 + 2304)

⇒ l = √2500

⇒ l = 50

Curved surface area of the tomb = (22/7) × 14 × 50

⇒ 22 × 2 × 50

⇒ 2200 m²

Total cost to plaster = 2200 × 150

⇒ Rs. 330000

**∴ The cost of plastering its curved surface area is Rs. 330000.**
